voice.notes: Default adult male, f0 ~110-115 Hz (S01-S03), casual US storyteller, gossip / 'can you believe this' tone, steady fast pace 200-240 wpm, longest pause <= 0.4 s. A female narrator (f0 ~200 Hz, S04) is used for a female celebrity: pick one with creative_list_voices and put its id in female_voice_id. Prompt tag: [casual, amused, fast-paced, like telling a friend wild celebrity gossip].

image_prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, {scene}. One person, {person_desc}, full body, centred, standing on the ground plane, real clothes, real props and real background in natural light. Their head AND neck are a flat 2D cartoon meme drawing (see head_prompt). Everything else stays a real photograph.
head_prompt: Replace the person's whole head and neck with a flat 2D cartoon meme drawing in the style of the reference head: flat warm skin fill with soft cel shading, thin clean black outline, slightly oversized head, simple line nose, white almond eyes with small black pupils and a heavy upper-lid line, thick short brows, mouth as a small line or dark open shape, hair and beard as flat shapes with a few strands, keeping the person's real hairstyle, hair colour, facial hair, skin tone, earrings and glasses so they are recognisable as a caricature. Expression: {expression}. Keep the body, clothes, hands, props, lighting and background exactly unchanged. The cartoon head must look drawn, never photoreal.

image_edit_prompts.expression: Same picture, only change the cartoon head's expression to {expression}; keep everything else identical
image_edit_prompts.pose: Same person with the same cartoon head, outfit and background, now {pose}
image_edit_prompts.side_character: Add a {role} standing {where}, real photo body and clothes with a flat 2D cartoon meme head and neck in the same style, expression {expression}
image_edit_prompts.thought_bubble: Add a white cloud thought bubble with a thin black outline at the top-left, its tail of small circles pointing to the person's head, containing a small flat cartoon picture of {content}
image_edit_prompts.pov_phone: First-person POV photo looking down at two real hands holding a smartphone over the lap, the screen shows {content}
image_edit_prompts.empty_plate: Remove the person completely and fill in the background naturally; keep the camera, light and every other object unchanged

video_prompt: The cartoon-headed person {action}; camera locked, background still, head stays a flat 2D drawing and moves rigidly with the body (no lip sync, no 3D turning)
music_prompt: Dark-curious minor-key underscore for a celebrity weird-facts short: muted plucks or soft piano ostinato, light trap hi-hats and soft 808, 117-130 bpm, no vocals, steady, loops cleanly, slightly mysterious gossip feel

captions.notes: capfont IoU on S01 'ALIEN': Titan One 0.46 / Rubik Black 0.44 / Work Sans Black 0.44 (real face not installed). Rubik Black chosen by burn test: same weight and wide round letters; Titan One too blobby, Poppins Black too thin. S04 uses a bigger cartoon display face (Titan One look, ~0.045 of the height) - variant 'big_captions' below.

countdown.notes: white disc with a soft grey bevel and a heavy black number, top-left, appears after the title line, steps 10 -> 1 on fact boundaries (about every 5-6 s); '1' holds to the end. S04 variant: plain white '10.' with black outline (style 'text').

watermark.notes: samples carry the channel handle bottom-centre, small white, half transparent. Use the user's own handle or nothing - never the sample channel's.

kicks.use: on violent / shock words (shooting, fight, crash, scream), 0-2 per video, with a red edge vignette pulse

edit.beats: new scene every 1.5-2.5 s (one picture per clause); the camera mostly holds still, then SNAPS (3-4 frame attack) into a punch-in or pull-out on the key word; hard cuts between scenes, short dissolves (0.32-0.4 s) between facts

animation.heads: cartoon head + neck baked into the picture by the image edit (not a layer); expression = a new edited picture swapped on the word
animation.bodies: people are cut-out blocks over an empty plate: walk in / walk across (2-4 pose pictures swapped at ~5 Hz while the block slides), turn-around = horizontal squash to a sliver and back with the next pose, sit down / stand up as pose swaps
animation.objects: cars, planes, chairs, money stacks, phones as blocks that slide or pop in; side characters with their own toon heads

limits: The samples' walk cycles look like AI video or 3-4 pose drawings; stills-motion fakes them with pose swaps on a sliding block, or uses a 2-3 s image-to-video clip per walk
The cartoon head is drawn by the image model: keep one head reference per celebrity and chain every pose / expression from it, then check identity on a contact sheet
Caption face is not the sample's exact font (IoU 0.44); Rubik Black is the closest OFL face installed
Real people: the head must stay an obvious caricature (flat, outlined) - never a photoreal face or deepfake-like lip sync
